'''R2-D4''' was one of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] employed by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency. R2-D4's stats could be seen in a [[droidnostics]] panel at a [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid could only be seen in the form of a schematic on a "droidnostics" panel in the queue of the original version of the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction in [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="ST" /> Despite its name the droid features a head design normally seen on [[R5-series astromech droid]]s.<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
